verdicts.title: Symplectic reduction of quasi-morphisms and quasi-states
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We prove that quasi-morphisms and quasi-states on a closed integral symplectic manifold descend under symplectic reduction to symplectic hyperplane sections. Along the way we show that quasi-morphisms that arise from spectral invariants are the Calabi homomorphism when restricted to Hamiltonians supported on stably displaceable sets.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract discusses quasi-morphisms, quasi-states, and symplectic reduction on symplectic manifolds, with no mention of boolean circuits, circuit size, or any complexity-theoretic bound involving symplectic area.

verdicts.title: Translated points for contactomorphisms of prequantization spaces over monotone symplectic toric manifolds
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We prove a version of Sandon's conjecture on the number of translated points of contactomorphisms for the case of prequantization bundles over certain closed monotone symplectic toric manifolds.
